Name: Mermaid Island Unofficial QoL Patch (Unsupported)
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000]Mermaid Island is not currently updated for SDV 1.6, so this mod will do nothing.[/color][/b]

This is a series of small modifications to two maps from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4216]Mermaid Island[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/60742951]TrentXV[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51209496]HisameArtWork[/url]. It requires Mermaid Island v3.2.8 ﻿and all of its prerequisites to do anything at all, and will not funciton without it.

Unfortunately the current version of TrainStation deposits players returning from Mermaid Island [i]inside [/i]the ticket machine in Willy's back room, meaning that if you are not running NoClip, you will become trapped. This mod aims to work around this issue.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15890/15890-1749853383-1925416283.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Adds a rowboat to Willy's back room that allow you to transition to Mermaid Island without using the TrainStation ticket machine.
[*]Modifies the existing rowboat to the north of Mermaid Island both as the entry and exit point for the map.
[*]Removes the ticket machine from the south of Mermaid Island.
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15890/15890-1749853389-1554067844.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.5 ([b]NOT [/b]compatible with 1.6+)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4216]Mermaid Island[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/60742951]TrentXV[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51209496]HisameArtWork[/url] (and all of its prerequisites, excluding TrainStation)
[/list][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15890/15890-1749853396-1649524688.png[/img][/center]
This mod contains four files; an updated content.json file, and three .tmx map patches (one for Willy's back room, and two for Mermaid Island). If you manually install your mods, simply drop my "Mermaid Island" folder from the zip file over the existing one in your Stardew mods folder. If you use a mod manager, [i]merge [/i]this mod with the original Mermaid Island.

[b]Important Extra Step: [/b]Within the Mermaid Island folder, rename "[TrainStops] Island" to ".[TrainStops] Island" to completely remove TrainStation as a requirement (you could also delete the folder, but this allows you to easily revert the changes by changing the name back if you so choose). If you do not rename or remove this folder, the ticket machine in Willy's back room will retain the ability to send you to Mermaid Island, which you do [i]not [/i]want.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15890/15890-1749853403-1297118528.png[/img][/center]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/60742951]TrentXV[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51209496]HisameArtWork[/url] for Mermaid Island itself, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/60742951]TrentXV[/url]﻿ specifically for giving me the go-ahead to release this quick and easy fix for my own personal use to the public.
